description: Create a webhook subscription that pushes grant-change events matching a filter. Cost: $0.20 USDC via x402 (paid by the agent runtime, not the MCP server). On payment failure or missing capability, returns a structured 402 with the payment requirements so the caller agent can satisfy and retry.

callback_url.description: HTTPS URL that receives POSTed events

hmac_secret.description: Shared secret used to HMAC-SHA256 sign delivery payloads

name: subscribe_changes
